stories.title: Marcos appoints lawyer Saquilabon as new DOH undersecretary
stories.summary:
Marcos appoints lawyer Saquilabon as new DOH undersecretary. MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R.

Marcos Jr. has appointed lawyer Christian Lel Saquilabon as a new undersecretary of the Department of Health, following the courtesy resignation of Health Undersecretary Dr. Emmie Liza “Molly” Perez-Chiong.

Saquilabon’s appointment was approved by Marcos on Aug. 4, based on an appointment document shared to Malacañang reporters on Sunday.

stories.summary:

Under Memorandum Circular No. 123, face-to-face classes at all levels in public and private schools are also suspended.

stories.title: ‘Habagat’ topples trees, triggers landslide in Baguio City
stories.summary:
‘Habagat’ topples trees, triggers landslide in Baguio City. BAGUIO CITY—Heavy rains dumped by the southwest monsoon or “habagat” toppled trees and triggered a landslide in the Magsaysay area on Saturday evening, prompting firefighters to conduct clearing operations and advise nearby residents to evacuate.

The incident happened along No. 8-B Private Road at 7:18 p.m., according to the Bureau of Fire Protection-Cordillera Administrative Region.
